name: recall_first_number
description: Recall the first element written in a Python list of numbers, prompted by a comment ('# first element written:'). Control: identical format but the list holds English words, so recall is of a word rather than a number.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
W=["apple","river","stone","cloud","tiger","piano","lemon","house","chair","glass","bread","green","mouse","train","plant","sugar","candle","forest","window","silver","garden","orange","pencil","rocket","castle","dragon","guitar","jacket","marble","planet"]
def make(ctrl,n=120):
    out=[]
    for _ in range(n):
        if ctrl:
            xs=random.sample(W,5); lit="["+", ".join(repr(x) for x in xs)+"]"
            p=f">>> xs = ['cat', 'dog']\n# first element written: 'cat'\n>>> xs = {lit}\n# first element written:"
            a=f" '{xs[0]}'"
        else:
            xs=random.sample(range(10,99),5)
            p=f">>> xs = [1, 2]\n# first element written: 1\n>>> xs = {xs}\n# first element written:"
            a=f" {xs[0]}"
        out.append({"prompt":p,"answer":a})
    return out
json.dump({"items":make(False),"control":make(True)},open("/work/skill.json","w"))
